en: Points of Controversy (Kathāvatthu) The Great Fifty-Section (Mahāpaṇṇāsaka) The Twenty-first Chapter (Ekavīsatimavagga)
The Discourse on the Buddhas: Is there a distinction of inferiority or superiority among the Buddhas by means of other Buddhas? Yes.
"Is it from the foundations of mindfulness?
One should not say so... pe ...
"Is it from the right efforts?"... pe ...
From the basis of psychic power … from the faculties … from the powers …
Is it from the perspective of the factors of enlightenment … from the perspective of mastery … [and so on] … from the perspective of the knowledge and vision of omniscience?
It should not be stated thus… [etc.
…The Discussion on the Buddha is finished.
